name: Panda Express The Original Orange Chicken (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Dark meat chicken chunks coated in thick flour batter, deep-fried until crisp, and tossed in a sweet-spicy chili sauce made with citrus orange peel, chili peppers, garlic, and vinegar. High acid + capsaicin + frying oil guarantees mucosal irritation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active flares. Choose Grilled Teriyaki Chicken (without sauce) or String Bean Chicken instead.
